issue.title: 質問票をラジオボタン化し、承認付きキャンペーン作成までつなぐる

summary: Convert structured setup choices to accessible radio inputs and produce a campaign draft plus human execution procedure; defer campaign-create API mutation.
decisions: Split the issue: implement radio questionnaire, scoped draft, review, and human procedure now.
Campaign creation API is excluded because current policy allows only campaign status and budget writes.
Any future campaign-create route requires a new explicit product/security approval and requirements change.

risks.description: Implementation may accidentally add a forbidden campaign mutation.
risks.mitigation: Contract and tests assert draft-only output and absence of campaign-create provider calls.

risks.description: Auth or navigation may lose questionnaire progress.
risks.mitigation: Persist scoped intake answers and cover resume behavior in browser tests.

gates.description: The accepted scope is questionnaire, draft, and human procedure only.
A separate approval is required if campaign-create mutation is proposed later.

acceptanceCriteria: Single-choice questions use labelled keyboard-operable radios.
Answers persist within the correct user/workspace intake and resume safely.
Completion returns a structured campaign draft and explicit human procedure.
No Agent tool or API route can create a Google Ads campaign.

rollback.strategy: Return to the prior setup intake renderer while preserving stored answers; never roll forward to provider mutation.
rollback.verification: Existing intake can resume and provider fakes show zero campaign-create calls.
